E0609

`use alias.item` but item is private (D-MOD3)

What

`use alias.item` but item is private (D-MOD3)

Why

The registered sema rule applies here

Fix

Follow the guidance for E0609

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0609: tests/ui/module_inline_private.stderr.

Error [E0609]: `helper` is private in module `math`
  --> tests/ui/module_inline_private.jet:5:18
    |
  5 | fn run() { print(math.helper(5)) }
    |                  ^^^^
 Why: only `pub` items in an inline module are reachable from outside it
 Fix: add `pub` before `fn helper` in module `math`
